answer.evidence: radon/raw.py:72-79 defines _find(tokens, token, value). It iterates enumerate(reversed(tokens)) to find the rightmost matching (token type, text) pair, and it ends with raise ValueError('(token, value) pair not found') when nothing matches. Review points: check that the index taken from the reversed enumeration is converted back to a position in the original list, and that the docstring's "position of the rightmost term" matches what is returned. The caller around raw.py:164 catches ValueError, so check that the fallback path there is correct when the pair is absent. radon/complexity.py:41 raises ValueError for a negative complexity, which is a separate error path, so confirm it doesn't share handling with _find. A grep for the same lookup found no matches in radon/visitors.py, so review that file only for indirect interactions with token handling. radon/metrics.py had no matches and needs only a brief look.
